weaponId: # Scripted effects the plain weapon stats miss (research mechanics_report.md 6.2). Read by JAOWeapons when "Value special weapons" is on.
# shieldDamageMult: x damage vs shields. armorExtraPerHit: armor damage per hit that ignores armor reduction (can't hurt hull).
# arcChancePerHullHit / arcsPerSecond: EMP arcs (energy damage + EMP); arcPiercesShields TRUE when they can pierce at high target hard flux.
# targetShieldTakenMult: debuff on the target's shield while hit. softFluxOnShields: payload beams. ownedOnly: restricted/no-drop
shieldDamageMult: used only if already in the pool.
